title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian contingent preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Asian Games 2026: Lakshya, Sindhu Face Tough Draws; Satwik-Chirag Get Easier Path
indian_angle: Indian fans will be watching closely as the draws for top players like Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu, and Satwik-Chirag are revealed for the Asian Games.
summary: India's badminton stars Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu face challenging draws at the Asian Games 2026, while the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty appear to have a more favorable path.

title: Indian Men's Team Secures Bronze Medal at Asian Games 2026
indian_angle: The Indian men's badminton team has proudly earned a bronze medal at the Asian Games, showcasing their strong performance on the international stage.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team concluded their Asian Games 2026 campaign with a bronze medal after a hard-fought semi-final loss to China, marking a significant achievement for the squad.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for enhancing the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to the overall development of the sport in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, which ran from September 14th to 23rd.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how junior domestic tournaments are played across India, affecting player strategies and match dynamics.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
